facts.text: Caroline attended an LGBTQ conference two days before the session, where she met and connected with people who had similar experiences.

evidence.quote: I went to an LGBTQ conference two days ago and it was really special. I got the chance to meet and connect with people who've gone through similar journeys.

facts.text: Caroline struggled with mental health and found support that was helpful, which made her realize the importance of having a support system for others.

evidence.quote: I struggled with mental health, and support I got was really helpful. It made me realize how important it is for others to have a support system.

facts.text: Caroline is currently looking into counseling and mental health career options to help others on their journeys, similar to the support she received.

evidence.quote: I'm still looking into counseling and mental health jobs. It's important to me that people have someone to talk to, and I want to help make that happen.

facts.text: Melanie expressed admiration for Caroline's drive to help others with their mental health and acknowledged the importance of community support.

evidence.quote: Your drive to help is awesome! What's your plan to pitch in?
You're so inspiring for wanting to help others with their mental health.
